title: புத்திர பாக்கியம் மற்றும் புத்திர தோஷம் (Progeny Blessing / Putradosham)
description: 5th house and Jupiter (Putrakaraka) must be unafflicted by 6th/8th/Badhaka lords and free from Rahu-Ketu eclipsing for smooth child blessings.

title: குழந்தைகள் ஆணா? பெண்ணா? - 15 முக்கிய விதிகள் (Child Gender Indications)
description: 5th lord visible in male sign = Male child; in female sign = Female child. 5th lord hidden (3,6,8,12 from 5th): in male sign = Female child; in female sign = Male child. Guru+Ketu = Male child; Guru+Rahu = Female child. Retrograde Guru in Ketu star = Male child; in Rahu star = Female child.

title: இரட்டை குழந்தை யோகம் (Twins Progeny Rule)
description: Lagna or 5th lord placed in Ubaya Rasis (Mithunam, Kanni, Dhanusu, Meenam), or connected with Mercury, Jupiter, Rahu/Ketu leads to twin birth.

title: தத்து புத்திர யோகம் (Child Adoption Rule)
description: 9th and 10th lords conjunct (Dharma-Karmadhipati) with connection to two out of Sun, Jupiter, Saturn, Ketu indicates adoption of a child.

title: புத்திர சோகம் மற்றும் குறைபாடுகள் (Child Sorrows / Developmental Issues)
description: Afflicted 5th house/Guru with Rahu/Ketu/Saturn or Mercury + (2,3 lords afflicted) causes speech/hearing impediments or developmental delays.
